title: Recognition Without Authorization: LLMs and the Moral Order of Online Advice

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-generated relationship advice against top-voted human comments from r/relationship_advice using lexicon-based linguistic metrics to measure differences in directiveness, epistemic certainty (hedging vs. boosters), relationship orientation (leave vs. stay), and deontic permission-granting.

Analyzing how LLM safety alignment imposes a standardized therapeutic neutrality and algorithmic monoculture that overrides localized community vernaculars, moral orders, and context-specific prescriptive norms.
